output_list.reason: The multiplication operation can result in an overflow if the initialSupply is too large. This can lead to incorrect token supply calculations.
The requirement `require(balanceOf[_to] + _value > balanceOf[_to]);` is incorrect. It should be `require(balanceOf[_to] >= _value);`.
The ownership transfer function does not have any access control checks, which means that any address can call the `transferOwnership` function and transfer ownership to any address.
The constructor of the `WMCToken` contract has a typo in the function call. It should be `TokenERC20(initialSupply, tokenName, tokenSymbol) public {}`.
